In bv_sluice: row 8 x15-20 is '~', row 9 and rows 10-14 x9-20 are '#', and row 15 x9-24 is '#'. In bv_catwalk: row 5 x15-20 is '~' and rows 6-7 x15-20 are '#'. The new test swept 72 Jump+Echo Jump timings per fighter per room: 0 crossings (old code: Vellix 14/72 and 7/72). Dash windows are still at least 25 px for every fighter.

js/characters.js blinkPastBoss(): this is decided on the frame the slide would enter a boss body. If the remaining slide reaches the far side (with footing for half the body and no wall there), it passes through. Otherwise it stops flush at the near side, where the hitbox still reaches. It never ends inside the boss. Test: from 200, 160 and 100 px it deals 7, never overlaps the boss after the slide, and takes no contact hit.

js/world.js + DESIGN.md: the dc_fall row-40 grate is extended to x13-19 (row 40 x13-15 changed from '.' to '-'). A row-34 crumble plank that gives way now drops the fighter 6 rows onto that grate, on camera and on the descent route, instead of onto the off-screen spike bed. Test: 9 drops (3 fighters × 3 x positions) all land at y 1200 with no hazard.

World part only: bv_sluice row 2 x5-8 changed from '#' to '.', so the arrival chamber is open at rows 2-7 over x1-8. After the T arrival, holding RIGHT walks off the grate's end and drops into the crawlspace. Down+Jump still works. Test: Tessik, Brackmaw and Korvask land at y 120, then holding RIGHT alone reaches x ≥ 300 on the floor at y 240 with no hazard. The existing qa-progression D5/H7/R2/S1 and the playthrough still pass.

js/bosses.js tallockPick: a fighter standing on a grate at least 60 px above Tallock's feet is never given the floor-only Slab Swing or Stomp Quake. Within 95 px he picks Stack Shrug (60%) or Stack Slam (40%); farther away, Slam or Disc. Test: over 15 s of shelf camping he made no floor-only picks, the camper took at least 3 hits, and Tallock was not beaten in 10.4 s.

js/bosses.js: new Stack Shrug attack. A takeHit wrapper counts down-strikes that land on Tallock. The count resets when the fighter touches ground. On the 3rd head pogo in a row, the Shrug tell starts at once if he is walking or recovering, or as his next pick otherwise. Tell: 24 f (20 f when enraged, never below the floor), the stack squats, the top discs and visor glow, and inked chevrons rise over his head. Active 8 f: a box 170 wide from 90 px above his top to 40 px below it, so it never reaches the floor. 1 damage, 40 f recovery. Test: a Brackmaw pogo bot triggers it and takes the 'shrug' hit; every tell is at least 20 f and fires only after 3 or more pogos.

js/entities.js chainShove() + js/enemies.js hurtTick (+ E.applyHit / applyDamage): L1 and L2 hits are now shoves. The victim keeps the sheet knockback velocity and slide, so the qa-combat sheet checks and the qa-enemies 'knockback 2.1 px/f' check are unchanged. But the slide stops at the reach of the attacker's next light: that box's front edge (Overclock reach included) plus the victim's half width, minus 8 px. A victim already beyond that is never pulled back. L3, heavies and specials are untouched. Test: L1, L2 and L3 all land for all five fighters on a stationary scuttlebit 40 px ahead (old code: Tessik and Brackmaw L3 whiffed), and L3's kb on the hit frame equals the sheet value.

js/bosses.js: during the tell the marker follows the fighter (clamped so the stack fits the arena). At tell end it freezes at slamX, the landing x, and stays drawn through the whole slam arc, brighter and with an ink rim. Test (spy on the draw context): 49 of 49 arc frames show the marker at slamX, and Tallock lands there.

js/bosses.js tallockUnpin(): set when a Stack Slam lands and whenever one of Tallock's own hits connects (the Slab Swing knocked fighters back toward its box centre, i.e. into his body). On the next frame an overlapping fighter is pushed clear: to the side of their centre, or the other side when that side is a wall. Any into-the-boss vx is zeroed. The landing touch itself is still the slam's hit. Test: a fighter idling at the left wall for 30 s overlaps the grounded stack for at most 1 frame (old: 673 frames), with 1 body-contact hit (old: 10).

js/bosses.js SHOTS.snare.step: a fighter coming down onto the thread from above (previous-frame feet at or above its top) treads it flat. It snaps with spark and dust and does no damage. A fighter standing in it when it is laid is still caught for 1. Test: jumping it 6 f before the tell ends lands unhurt (the thread snaps at f51, landing at f53); standing still is still hit for 1 (tag 'snare').

Bosses part (js/bosses.js). Every boss now updates focusX/focusY each tick: Tallock and Weftyr the body, Corrosant the head, Kernauth the chest core or flying core. Corrosant also draws an edge beacon while its head is above the view: an inked fin-coloured chevron over a small head wedge, pulsing, placed at the head's x and dropped below the HUD block when the head is over it. Test: the head sits at y 112 while the floor camera's view starts at y 180; rendering with and without the beacon changes the view's top band, and focusY equals the head y. Camera framing is in engine_requests.

js/bosses.js (Kernauth). Root Spikes are now bleached bone #f2e4c2 with a 4 px ink outline and a 1.5 px white edge. Their tell marks are bone ellipses with an ink outline plus a dashed 'hot' riser above each one, so a mark stays visible around a fighter standing on it. Both cable-arms now sit on a pale #e8c79a rim under their ink and fill. This also fixed a latent bug: cableTip used to start at 0, which drew the right cable across the whole arena until the first sweep; it now starts at home. Test (rendered pixels): spikes 11.7:1 against the background and 4.1:1 against the red floor edge (old 1.66 and 1.58); every strip of the cable has a pixel at least 3:1 against the background.

js/characters.js: the Overclock countdown, warning and end are skipped while player.locked is true (the boss intro card and the 120 f ability pickup). The aura FX still runs. Test: across the pickup the timer goes 719 → 718 (old: 719 → 599).

js/characters.js. Player.update now wraps updateBody, then runs a refused-press check. A Special, Overclock or Dash press whose 6 f buffer reaches its last frame unconsumed, while the fighter canAct(), now:
- plays the deny sfx
- sets denyT/denyKind and draws an 18 f cue over the fighter's head (an inked DANGER ring with a slash)

Presses lost to hurt, a lock, death or the Overclock transform stay silent. The existing immediate denies (energy short, second Pulse Line, light-cancel refusal) now go through the same deny() helper, keeping their 10 f lockout. A Pulse Line with less than 30 px of floor ahead (same footing rule as the wave) is refused with deny and no energy spent. Tests cover: mid-air special, special during its own Pulse Line, Vellix special in the L3 chain end, Overclock at meter 60, Dash without Burst Line, and a Pulse Line off a grate end (no energy spent). A control check confirms a Pulse Line with a runway still fires with no deny.

js/characters.js drawPreview: the jump showcase lift is now pose-aware. A new rigTop() measures the posed rig, compared against the cached idle top. The rig's highest point rises at most jumpHeight × 0.25 × scale/3 (about 28 px for Tessik at ×3), and the airborne pose's own reach counts toward that. Test (offscreen pixels over all jump frames, all five fighters): the top stays at y ≥ 92, inside the halo (old: y 0-4, over the header), and the lift is still 24-40 px.

js/characters.js Player.draw: on the i-frame blink-off beats the fighter is no longer skipped. fixed.change: js/engine.js: new Game.prototype.defeatBoss(bossId) runs the real defeat path. If the boss is live in the room, it ends an intro in progress (mode normal, player unlocked, card cleared), spends any remaining phases through boss.nextPhase (Kernauth's throne bursts, phase 2), sets hp 0 and calls startBossDeath. That plays the death FX, pops every boss shot and records + saves the defeat, and the dying → reward flow then runs as after a real kill: bits, sparks, the ability module, and for Kernauth the victory screen 190 f later. It always records the defeat, grants the ability, lifts the arena's seal + locked exits and writes the save (the DESIGN §16.9 contract existing tests rely on). UB.debug.defeatBoss() with no id now targets the boss live in the room (else the room's unbeaten boss record). An unknown id or nothing to defeat returns false, so null never enters bossesDefeated. Game.toTitle now resets bossFight, pickupSeq, nodeUse, transition, hazard/hazardTo, zoom, denyFlash and hitstop, so a quit mid-fight leaves bossFight 'none'. 7 checks in the new test/pt-fixes-engine.cjs; all 7 fail with HEAD's engine.js.

js/engine.js camera. cameraTarget x is the midpoint of the fighter and boss.focusX, but never closer than 40 px to a side edge; without this, a boss across rw_throne's 1920 px could leave the fighter about 420 px off-screen. updateCamera y keeps the dead band while focusY lies within [70, 430] of the view. Otherwise it eases (0.12) toward putting the focus 70 px under the top edge (or 110 px over the bottom), then hard-clamps to the fighter's bounds: feet at screen y ≤ 444 (above the boss bar), head ≥ 70 px under the top, so a fall never outruns the view. Result in bv_corrosant: from the row-16 and row-11 grates the head sits at screen y 70; from the floor the room limit keeps today's framing and the gameplay lane's beacon marks the head. Added js/ui.js drawBossEdge: when a boss's focus is off the view to the left or right, a pulsing inked chevron in the boss's accent colour sits at that edge (y 140–466). It is not drawn under overlays, and it skips the above-the-view case for a boss with its own beacon (new flag beaconTop, set in bosses.js createCorrosant). Only rendering reads the camera. 9 checks; HEAD's engine fails the grate and rw_throne ones.

Root fix, optional request. js/engine.js adds Game.prototype.knockOrigin(hit, player), which resolveHits passes to player.hurt. The origin is the hit box centre, except for a melee box touching the attacker's own body (hit.src is game.boss or a listed enemy, and the box reaches within src.w/2 + 8 px of it) with the fighter standing between that body and the box centre: then the origin is src.x, so the fighter is knocked away from the body. Projectiles and boxes away from the body keep the box centre. Tallock's Slab Swing no longer knocks a fighter at his front edge into him; the gameplay lane's tallockUnpin stays as a backstop. 2 checks (old code knocked the fighter into the body).

Design choices:
- B38 framing departs from the lane's suggested formula, which always pulled the view toward the focus. That would also have re-framed Tallock, Weftyr and Kernauth. Mine keeps the dead band whenever the focus is already in frame, overrides only when it is not, and clamps hard to the fighter's bounds after easing.
- On bv_corrosant's floor the room clamp leaves the feet at screen y 450, still above the boss bar at 486. DESIGN says so.
- I added the generic side-edge marker because the 40 px side clamp can push a boss more than about 880 px away off-screen sideways in the 1440–1920 px arenas.
- knockOrigin only applies to boxes that touch the attacker's body, so spikes, needles and the cable tip keep their box-centre knockback.
- A debug defeat during an intro calls UI.clearMessages(), so it also clears any toast. This is debug-only.
